general.title: Refresh interval and monitoring sensors
general.description: Whole seconds from 5 to 300 are allowed. Short intervals cause correspondingly frequent cloud requests and may be rate limited. Defaults: G1T 120 seconds, G2T 30 seconds. Select the local sensors for future PV charging analysis. The wallbox power sensor is provided by this integration and does not need selection.

data.battery_soc_entity: Home battery state of charge sensor

control.title: PV charging control (mode 5)
control.description: Settings for HA charging mode 5, activated via the charging mode select option "PV-Eigenverbrauch (Modus 5)". Defaults are based on the measurement cycle of 2026-10-13; power limits and battery values are provisional proposals.

data.grid_import_limit_w: Grid import protection: tolerance above permitted import

data_description.active_vehicle_profile: Vehicle profile with the charging stages (phases, current, power) the controller chooses from.
data_description.control_strategy: Step control changes one stage per decision (calmer); direct control jumps straight to the matching stage (faster). Applies to increasing and decreasing.
data_description.average_window_seconds: PV, house load and grid import are averaged over this period before a regular decision is made. Applies to increasing and decreasing. Longer = calmer but slower.
data_description.unstable_average_window_seconds: Used while a stage marked unstable is active, so that power oscillation does not trigger further changes. Applies to increasing and decreasing.
data_description.current_change_wait_seconds: Pause after a current change or a failed command before averaging restarts. Measured: the wallbox reacts about 25–29 s after the command. Applies in both directions.
data_description.phase_change_wait_seconds: Pause after a phase change or a switch to/from mode 1. Measured: charging pauses about 35–45 s after the command for 10–15 s. Applies in both directions.
data_description.allowed_grid_import_w: This grid import may be used for charging permanently: the controller works with surplus + this value when starting, increasing and decreasing. 0 = PV surplus only. With a home battery, the battery may discharge instead of the grid (mind the minimum SOC).
data_description.grid_import_limit_w: Decreasing only: grid import protection triggers when the average grid import exceeds the permitted grid import while charging by more than this amount. Higher = more grid import is tolerated before reducing.
data_description.grid_import_protection_seconds: Decreasing only: if the average grid import stays above the limit for this long, power is reduced immediately without waiting for the full averaging window. Longer = slower. At most the averaging window.
data_description.reaction_confirm_seconds: If the house load stays within the range of the expected new load for this long after a command, the wait ends early. If other consumers change the load, the full wait applies. 0 = off.
data_description.surplus_reserve_w: Increasing only: increase only if the average surplus exceeds the power of the next stage by at least this amount. Higher = less oscillation and grid import, but more feed-in.
data_description.min_battery_soc: Below this home battery state of charge the controller switches the wallbox to mode 1 (the wallbox's own surplus charging).
data_description.battery_soc_hysteresis: After SOC protection, control resumes only once the home battery exceeds the minimum SOC by this amount.
data_description.sensor_stale_seconds: If a sensor delivers no new value for this long, the measurement is invalid and the wallbox is switched to mode 1 as a fallback.
data_description.sensor_recovery_seconds: All sensors must be valid again for this long before control resumes after a sensor error.

vehicle_add.title: Add vehicle
vehicle_add.description: Enter the stable charging power after settling for each phase/current combination. Unstable stages are used with a longer averaging period; excluded stages are never selected.

vehicle_edit.title: Edit vehicle
vehicle_edit.description: Enter the stable charging power after settling for each phase/current combination. Unstable stages are used with a longer averaging period; excluded stages are never selected.
